title: Prove six calls for the open three-value shear case (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Three independent dirty-source transfers `y_j += (C-I)x_j` require exactly six C/C^-1 calls when the character spectrum is {1,i,-1}, even with arbitrary constant invertible complex role mixing and any finite number of restored dirty helpers. This is a scoped algebraic proof with exact finite corroboration, resolving Open next question 1 of Richard Hoekstra's merged #1318. No new kappa is claimed.

```text
four independent phase directions: two active values force incompatible rows
three-dimensional direction span: constant transfer image has rank at most two
six direct calls: complete rank-three dirty shear attained
```

The new first/last-row argument replaces the four-root interpolation needed by the predecessor's independent-direction argument. The normalized rank-one alphabet, direction-span split, canonical loops and upper construction retain Richard Hoekstra's credit. Only `research/three-spectrum-shear/` is added.

## Evidence

Before, #1318 explicitly left the three-value case open. After, PROOF.md excludes four calls at i and -1 and the exact checker reports:

```text
PASS_THREE_SPECTRUM_SHEAR minimum=6 loops=2 collapse_cases=81 upper_samples=6 controls=9 no_new_kappa
```

The checks use exact Q(i) arithmetic: both canonical coefficient maps and their constrained image ranks, 81 literal paired-collapse cases, six complete eight-role upper endpoints including dirty spectators, and nine controls. The written proof supplies the universal quantifiers; finite probes are corroboration. Generated RESULT.json binds mathematical fields to package/input hashes.

From the worktree root, CPython 3.12 standard library only:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/three-spectrum-shear/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/three-spectrum-shear/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/three-spectrum-shear
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/three-spectrum-shear --check-source-history
```

Other machines may substitute their CPython 3.12 path. Both registered commands pass locally in under one second each. Receipt-number, Boolean-for-one, own-source and inherited-input corruptions reject under optimized Python. No predecessor verifier or historical scientific suite is replayed.

## Task and overlap

Base canonical main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7. PR1318 head `5cc2496bbdae91e1f5d96d2ae340b42d2d776f24`; its retained proof and README are exact pinned inputs. The `complex-new-helper-inventory` card is explicitly changed to this algebraic interface side result. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19134000).

Live open/merged searches, relevant PR bodies, distinctive main README searches, active Discussions, recent account submissions and local question reservations were checked. The cached card scan reports complete pagination of 395 open PRs and 3,886 Discussion records, with incomplete sparse local-note coverage. Search absence is not a novelty certificate. Current selected source-binding orientation passed; no selected record is changed.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this same three-value rank-three shear question was identified in the targeted title/body searches. #1318 is the merged predecessor; this contribution answers its explicit open boundary without rechecking its four-value theorem.

- #4861 classifies mixed forward/inverse Clifford tensor lanes under a reciprocal full-space encoding. It concerns a different endpoint and quantity; it does not compute the dirty rank-three shear call minimum here. No common numerical result is rechecked.

The pre-DONE refresh inspected ten open PRs on this account created since the CLAIM, including this PR. None of the other nine studies the three-value rank-three same-phase shear minimum or reports a competing value. No extra predecessor computations were run.

## Limitations

The call floor assumes one common C/C^-1 phase function, character-independent constant mixing, complete arbitrary-dirty endpoints and restored helpers. Additional character-dependent gates, clean-only contracts and different phase functions are outside it. No physical tariff, new supplier, selected-frontier change or complete multiplication theorem follows. Native phase/compiler, finite-precision, fixed-tape, physical-hosting, supplier-admission, outer and Lean obligations were not run. No independent human or formal proof-kernel review is claimed.

## Open next questions

Can one explicitly paid additional character-dependent gate reduce the complete transfer bill? Specify its gate and tariff, then exhibit a complete dirty-restoring word. No such extra gate or invoice is supplied. Research stops at the first verified three-value result.
